mentions.name: Agency
mentions.description: A personal agent platform that lets non-developers connect multiple Gmail, Calendar, and other accounts and automate workflows across them, with chat, realtime voice, and Telegram interfaces.
mentions.problem: Non-developers still want to connect services like Gmail and Calendar and automate workflows across them.
mentions.audience: People who aren't necessarily developers but want to connect multiple accounts and automate workflows across them.
mentions.source_excerpt: First, https://agency.nu/ a personal agent platform for people who aren’t necessarily developers, but still want to connect multiple Gmail, Calendar, and other accounts and automate workflows across them. Spent a lot of time making the interaction easy and natural, so it supports chat, realtime voice and telegram.
